name: doodle-dash
description: A doodle-styled 3D platformer. Grab the Ink Star, find the door.
author: DataTree Studios

scripts.build:itch: vite build --mode itch && node tools/package-web.mjs itch
scripts.build:poki: vite build --mode poki && node tools/package-web.mjs poki
scripts.build:crazygames: vite build --mode crazygames && node tools/package-web.mjs crazygames
scripts.release: npm run validate && npm run build:itch && npm run build:poki && npm run build:crazygames && npm run build:exe
